direction: Approved conversational walkthrough. British George, normal sentence endings and no dramatic brand emphasis. No spoken closing tagline. Existing nine-second question scene preserves a pause before the answer.

phrases.text: Open T1 Arc and you can check your latest glucose reading,
phrases.spoken: Open Tee One Arc and you can check your latest glucose reading,

phrases.text: see which way it's moving,
and how recently it was updated.
Then you can look at what else has been happening.
How you slept, your workouts, your heart rate.
Information from your connected apps,
available here alongside your glucose.
You can also ask Tarv1s about that data,
phrases.spoken: You can also ask Tarvis about that data,

phrases.text: in your own words.
Say you want to check how yesterday went.
You could start with a simple question:
What was my average glucose yesterday?
Here, the average was six point six millimoles per litre.
You can open the readings behind the answer
and check what it used.
It helps explain your records, not recommend treatment.
To look more closely, open the timeline.
You can see glucose alongside meals, insulin and activity,
and follow what happened through the day.
And you can keep adding to that record as you go.
Search for a food, choose your portion,
and check the nutritional details before you save.
